values.note: Base sites $50 ($62 a night on holidays, 4-night minimum). Lake-end rows cost more: Scenic $55, View $65, Premium $75 ($70-$85 on holidays). Tribal use tax extra.
Monthly stays are offered, but from April 1 to October 1 the lower seven sites in each row (the lake end) are nightly only.

note: Chemehuevi Indian Tribe-owned resort campground on the California shore of Lake Havasu, beside the tribe's casino, marina and boat ramp; rows of sites run down to an open sand beach, with dry and tent camping areas too. Passenger ferry across the lake to Lake Havasu City. A mobile-home lease area lies next door. --Claude
summary: Havasu Landing (tribal/private): $50 base ($62 holidays, 4-night min), lake-end rows $55-$75, +$3.50 reservation fee and tribal use tax; Firefly engine, 30/50 amp; Google 4.1 (3,238) for the resort; no gateway but $50 is at the gate, not over; lakefront kept (row ends ~20-30 m from the water, ~2 m above it); phone to add.
flags: PRICE GATE: base 'ALL Other Sites Daily: $50 per night' before tribal use tax -- at the US$50 gate, not over it, so it passes. Holidays $62 (4-night minimum). No Good Sam (stored false) and gateways.py finds none within 40 km.

GOOGLE: 'Havasu Landing Resort & Casino' 4.1 (3,238 reviews) -- the resort-wide listing, which the campground shares; a 'The Landing' listing at 34.48674,-114.40690 (resort phone) has 4.6 (130). No separate campground listing found. Above the 4.0 line either way.

LONG-STAY: monthly rates are posted for every RV class ($365-$465 + electric) and winter monthly use is allowed everywhere; in summer the lake-end seven sites of each row are nightly only. Nightly booking runs on the Firefly engine with posted daily rates for every class, so test 2 passes; the nightly vs monthly share could not be measured (the engine is a JS app; no availability walk run). Next door is a separate mobile-home lease area ('Resident Portal', 'Leasing Application'), not the campground. Not 55+, no standing minimum outside holidays.
CASINO RV PARK: real nightly hookup sites (30 and 30/50 amp classes, numbered rows 101-825), not a parking lot.

WATERFRONT lakefront kept: the lake (01) ends of the rows -- the operator's Premium 101/401/501, View 201-801 and Scenic 102/103-802/803 sites, sold by the night and nightly-only in summer -- stop ~20-30 m from the water over open sand beach (imagery around 34.4874-34.4886,-114.4046); 3DEP puts the row ends ~2 m above Lake Havasu's steady level, a gentle slope (kayak test passes). The operator's map is from 2013 and not to scale, so which numbers sit closest is from the map, not measured per site.
